name: Tesla Bot
author: Matt Van Horn
summary: Controls Tesla charging, climate, locks, and navigation from chat, and reports charging costs through tesla-pp-cli.
starterPrompt: Explain the setup for my Tesla model and the permissions you need. Start with read-only vehicle status and ask before sending any live command.
usageNote: Requires Tesla account access and model-specific pairing. Review permissions carefully; confirm commands affecting locks, charging, or climate, and never share credentials in chat.
